core.title: White Porcelain Bail Pull, RK International CP-351

text.description_html:
RK International CP-351, Traditional White Porcelain Cabinet Pull

When looking for glamorous cabinet pulls, the options can often lean towards being gaudy, but the White Porcelain Bail Pull is beautiful without the overly ornateness. The combination of white porcelain and polished brass is truly lovely. This Traditional Porcelain Cabinet Pull has a 3 inch center to center. Comes packaged with all the installation hardware.

Specifications and Features of the RK International CP-351 White Porcelain Cabinet Hardware:

  • Length c.c. (center to center): 3"
  • Length Overall: 4"
  • Width: 1-3/16"
  • Material: porcelain with some brass
  • Screw: 1" long #8 - 32 machine screw.
  • Packaged with all necessary installation hardware.

Sold Individually
